europe_now.title: Zelensky reports Starshield restrictions
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the country faces systematic restrictions affecting the Starshield satellite network. He warned that these limitations are causing increased casualties among Ukrainians.

sources.headline: New restrictions to Starshield network 'kill more Ukrainians', Zelensky says
🔴Live: Zelensky says Ukraine facing 'systematic' restrictions to Starshield satellite network

europe_now.title: Russian strikes hit Ukrainian energy grid
europe_now.summary: Russian attacks targeting infrastructure have left many Ukrainians struggling with severe power blackouts, causing critical shortages of heat, light, and water. The disruptions have pushed the nation's overall power supply close to critical thresholds.

sources.headline: 'No light, no water, no heat': Ukrainians struggle with blackouts as Russia hits power grid
Ukraine's power supply close to critical as Russian strikes bring darkness and cold

top_stories.title: Hybrid Security Threats and Hoax Alarms
top_stories.summary: European leaders recently convened in Dublin to address rising regional concerns regarding hybrid security threats and disruptions. Meanwhile, authorities reported a wave of hoax bomb alerts sent to various schools across Italy and the United Kingdom.

sources.headline: Hybrid warfare: Hoax bomb alerts sent to schools in Italy, UK in latest disruption
European leaders gather in Dublin under the shadow of hybrid threats

top_stories.title: Political and Anticorruption Developments in Europe
top_stories.summary: A Polish deputy foreign minister has been formally charged in connection with the alleged misappropriation of millions of zloty. In the Netherlands, the ruling coalition government faces an acute political crisis ahead of an upcoming and crucial tax vote.
